Pahina Builder Master Guide
Everything, step by step, with pictures
Master Guide · Updated October 2026

Build pages that sell, with Pahina Builder

You describe your business. Pahina Builder writes the sales copy, designs the page, adds checkout, booking, chat, tracking and SEO, and hands you a finished website you own. This guide walks you through every screen, from your very first login to your hundredth page.

No codingNo monthly feeUnlimited pagesYour own website file
Part 1 · Getting started

1What Pahina Builder makes for you

One form in, one complete website out.

Every page Pahina Builder creates is a complete sales page and business website in a single file. It can include:

  • Sales copy written for your buyer: headline, pain points, benefits, what's included, FAQ, guarantee and a strong call to action.
  • A designed layout from 56 niche templates (salon, restaurant, clinic, real estate, courses, digital products and many more), or a fully custom design with AI Custom Design.
  • A working checkout button (GCash, Maya, PayPal, Stripe, Wise, Systeme.io, a payment link or manual payment), plus order bumps, coupons, bonuses and countdown timers.
  • Booking (request form, resort-style reservations, Calendly or a direct link), a chat bubble that answers visitors, and lead forms that save to your Google Sheet.
  • Extra pages: opt-in, upsell, downsell, thank you, about, services, pricing, FAQ, contact with Google Maps, and your own custom pages.
  • Automatic SEO, social share tags, Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4 and TikTok Pixel, A/B headline testing, legal pages and a cookie banner.

You download the finished page and put it online on a free host. After that, it is yours: no Pahina server in between and no monthly fee.

How it works behind the scenes: Pahina Builder runs on Google's Gemini AI engine with your own free key. You stay in control of every word, color and photo.

3Unlock your Pahina Builder

You only do this once per device.

  1. Open the email you received after your purchase. Look for the email with your access link. Check Promotions or Spam if you don't see it.
  2. Click the access link. Pahina Builder opens and unlocks automatically.
  3. No link handy? Copy the license key from the same email (it looks like FC-JUAN-A1B2C3), paste it in the box and click Unlock.

It won't ask again on this device. On a new phone or laptop, just click the access link in your email again.

Bought the Suite? Use the link from your Suite purchase email. Suite keys start with FC-suite. If you see an "Upgrade to Suite" button, you opened the app with a Builder key.

4Get your free Gemini key

This is the engine that lets Pahina Builder write and design. It takes 2 minutes.

  1. Open aistudio.google.com/apikey and sign in with your Google account. If it asks, accept the terms.
  2. You land on the API Keys page. Click Create API key at the top right.
  3. If it asks you to pick a project, choose any project (or let it create one for you), then confirm. Wait a few seconds while the key is created.
  4. The API key details window opens. Click Copy key. New keys start with AQ. (older keys start with AIza; both work).
  5. Go back to Pahina Builder and paste the key in the Gemini API Key bar at the top.

Once your key is saved, the bar shrinks to a small green chip. Click Change any time to paste a different key.

Is it really free? Google gives a free daily allowance that is more than enough for building pages. If you ever see a "quota" or "rate limit" message, wait a minute and try again. Heavy users can turn on billing in Google AI Studio.

Keep your key private. Never post it online or put it inside a page. Pahina Builder never puts your key in the pages it makes.

Part 2 · Build your first page

6The fast path: your first page in 10 minutes

Want to see results first and polish later? Do just these.

  1. Paste your Gemini key (Chapter 4).
  2. Answer the 7 Offer steps (Chapter 7). Use Help me write this when you're stuck.
  3. Upload a hero photo and your logo in Assets (Chapter 9).
  4. Pick a payment method in Payment (Chapter 11).
  5. Click Generate my page and wait 30 to 60 seconds (Chapter 15).

Everything else in this guide makes your page stronger, but none of it is required for your first Generate.

7Stage 1 · Offer: the 7-step wizard

The better your answers, the better Pahina Builder writes. Plain, specific words beat fancy ones.

StepWhat to writeExample
1 · Your OfferWhat you sell, in 1 or 2 sentences"A 90-minute hair spa and blowout that leaves frizzy hair soft for weeks."
2 · Ideal BuyerWho it's for, as specific as you can"Busy working women in Makati who want salon-quality hair."
3 · Their ProblemThe frustration they feel today"Their hair frizzes from heat and humidity."
4 · TransformationLife after buying from you"Glossy, manageable hair for 3 to 4 weeks."
5 · What's IncludedEverything they get, one per line"Scalp check / Hair spa / Blowout / Home care card"
6 · PricingSelling price, original price, price list, guarantee, deadline₱1,490, was ₱2,490
7 · Brand & ToneBrand and product name, video, tone, language, lengthGlow Studio · English, Modern

Step 6 · Pricing, and the extras on this step

  • My prices vary: turn on to show "From ₱350" instead of a fixed price.
  • Services & Price List: for businesses with many services. One per line as Name | Price | Short description. Start a line with ## to make a category. It becomes a clean price menu, and your chatbot learns your prices too.
  • Guarantee and Additional Info: Pahina Builder places these where they fit best.
  • Real Offer Deadline: a real countdown to an exact date. Evergreen Timer: a per-visitor countdown. Use Evergreen only for email, SMS or organic traffic, never for Facebook or Instagram ads, because fake scarcity can get ad accounts flagged.
  • Sticky Mobile CTA: keeps a "Buy Now" bar at the bottom of phone screens.
  • AI Directives + Industry Presets: one click fills smart instructions for Martial Arts/Gym, Clinic, Salon/Spa, Real Estate, Agency, Coaching/Courses, Restaurant or E-commerce. Or type your own instructions, like "add a section about our parking".
  • Team / Coaches List: one per line as Name | Role | Years | Short bio. Only tick "My Gallery Images ARE their photos" if you uploaded one photo per person, in the same order.
  • Awards & Milestones: one per line.

Step 7 · Brand & Tone

Which length? Standard works for most offers. Choose Long-Form for high-ticket or emotional offers where buyers need more convincing.

8Stage 2 · Brand: colors, fonts and templates

Choose how your page looks. Pahina Builder can also pick for you.

Brand Kit (great for freelancers)

  1. Fill in your brand details, logo, colors and fonts first.
  2. Type a kit name (for example, your client's business name) and click Save current as Brand Kit.
  3. Next time, click Apply on that kit to load everything into a new page. You can keep up to 10 kits on each device.

Your Brand Style

  • Color Palette: 19 ready palettes, or Custom to type your own colors.
  • Font Pairing: Poppins is recommended. Others include DM Sans, Playfair Display and Lora.
  • Button Style: gradient, solid, outline or pill.
  • Favicon: the small icon in the browser tab.
  • Apply my brand to the designed template: templates keep their own colors by default. Tick these boxes to use your colors, button style and headline font instead.

Templates and AI Custom Design

Designed templates

56 niche layouts with their own sections, colors and fonts. The layout stays the same every time, so you get a predictable, polished look. Use the search bar ("salon", "kape", "church") or the filters.

AI Custom Design

Turn the switch on and Pahina Builder designs the whole website for your business: modern, high-tech yet clean, with animations. Checkout, booking, chat and tracking are still added for you.

Want a different look? Turn Auto-pick off and choose another template, then Generate again. Every version is saved in the Versions tab, so you can compare.

You can also click Save Current Settings as Template (in My Custom Templates) to save your palette, font and button combo as a named style for future pages.

10Stage 2 · Story Page (optional)

A premium, magazine-style product page, inspired by Amazon A+ Content.

  1. Tick Include Product Story Page.

  3. Add Key Stats, one per line as Number | Unit | Label, for example 500 | + | Bottles sold monthly. Use only numbers you can back up.

Choose how buyers pay. Pahina Builder wires it into every button on your page.

  2. Open How do I deliver my product? and read it once. It explains manual, semi-automatic and automatic delivery.

MethodPaste thisBest for
GCash / MayaYour number, payment link or QRPhilippine buyers, manual confirmation
PayPal / Stripe / WiseYour payment or checkout linkInternational buyers, cards

Never put a paid download link on the Thank You page. Anyone can see it in the page code without paying. Send paid files privately, or use a checkout that delivers automatically.

Selling boosters on this tab

  • Order Bump: an add-on offer right before checkout, with an optional bundle price and bundle link.
  • Collect Full Name + Email before checkout: saves buyers to your Google Sheet (set up in Chapter 20).
  • Exit-Intent Popup: a last-chance offer when a visitor is about to leave.
  • Coupon Code: a simple "Have a coupon?" box for influencer promos. It shows a message; it does not change the checkout price.
  • Free Bonuses: one per line as Name | Value | Description. Shown with a running total before your price.
  • Earnings calculator: only for resell or business-opportunity offers.

Chat on your page

  • Smart FAQ Chatbot (default, free, no setup): while generating, Pahina Builder writes 25 to 40 questions and answers about your business and builds them into a chat bubble. It answers visitors instantly. When it doesn't know, it sends them to your Messenger, WhatsApp or email.
  • My own chatbot or chat link: paste your Messenger, WhatsApp or Pahina AI chat link.
  • No chat.

Changed your chatbot settings? Click Generate again so the new answers are built into the page.

Tracking & Analytics

See Chapter 22 for where to find your Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4 and TikTok Pixel IDs. Add a Social Share Preview Image URL (a hosted image link) so your link looks good when shared.

SEO, webhook, A/B testing, affiliates and legal

  • SEO: every page automatically gets an SEO title, description, share tags, structured data and image alt text. Add your Website URL once you know it, and an optional main keyword.
  • Lead Webhook: sends every lead to Zapier, Make.com, n8n or your CRM.
  • A/B Headline Testing: half your visitors see a second headline. Needs your GA4 ID. In Google Analytics, compare the ab_test_view and ab_test_conversion events by "variant".
  • Affiliate Link Generator: paste your live page link (not the app link) and an affiliate name to create a tracked link. Leads from it are tagged in your sheet.
  • Legal Pages: adds Privacy Policy, Terms and Disclaimer popups to your footer. Cookie consent banner: recommended if you expect visitors from Europe or the UK.

14Stage 4 · Ads & Prompts

Plan, check and improve your ads before you spend.

Ads Analyzer

Upload up to 3 ad images, paste your caption, choose platform and goal, add budget and results. You get a 0 to 100 score, what works, top fixes, 3 new captions, audiences, a budget plan, policy warnings and a 7-day plan. Download it as a text file.

Ads Strategist

Builds a full ad plan from your offer: objective, budget, 3 audiences, placements, creatives, a policy check, a testing plan, KPIs and a launch checklist.

Copy-ready prompts matched to your template and colors, for image and video tools. Each card tells you where to upload the result.

15Generate your page

The moment Pahina Builder puts it all together.

  1. Check the 4 chips. A green check means done. Click any chip to jump straight to it.
  2. Click Generate my page. It works once your key and offer are filled in.

19Put your page online

Pick one. All four are free.

Option A · Netlify Drop (2 minutes)

  1. If you downloaded a ZIP, unzip it first (right-click, Extract All).
  2. Open app.netlify.com/drop and sign up free.
  3. Drag your whole page folder onto the page. Your site is online in seconds.
  4. To get a nicer link, open Site configuration, then Change site name.

Option B · Vercel drag and drop (no GitHub needed)

  1. Unzip your page first if you downloaded a ZIP. Your folder should have index.html inside.
  2. Sign up free at vercel.com. On your dashboard, click Add New, then Project.
  3. On "Let's build something new", drag your page folder (or your single HTML file) onto the page, or click folder or file in "choose a file or a folder".
  1. Type a Project Name. It becomes your free link, for example glow-studio.vercel.app. Then click Deploy.
  1. In about a minute you'll see Congratulations! Click Continue to Project.
  2. Your live link is under Domains. Click it, or click Visit, to see your page online. Share this link everywhere.

Updating is easy: open your project on Vercel and drag your new page onto the project page. Your link stays the same.

Option C · GitHub + Vercel (best if you update often or work with a team)

  1. On github.com, click the + at the top right, then New repository.
  1. Type a Repository name (for example glow-studio), choose Public or Private, and click Create repository. Leave the other settings as they are.
  1. Click uploading an existing file. Drag in index.html and, if you have it, the images folder. Wait for the upload to finish, then click Commit changes.
  1. On Vercel, click Add New, then Project. Under Import Git Repository, find your repository, click Import, then Deploy. The first time, Vercel asks you to connect your GitHub account.
  2. To update later: open your repository, click Add file, then Upload files. Drop the new index.html and click Commit changes. Vercel updates your site in about a minute.

Double-check the repository before you commit. Uploading an index.html replaces the one already there. Make sure you're in the right repository for that page.

Option D · GitHub Pages

  1. Create a public repository and upload index.html and the images folder.
  2. Open Settings, then Pages. Choose Deploy from a branch, branch main, folder / (root), then Save.
  3. Wait 1 to 2 minutes and open the link GitHub shows.

The main file must be named index.html. The ZIP already uses that name. If you used Download, rename your file to index.html.

After you go live: paste your live link into Payment → SEO → Website URL and Generate once more. Then submit your site in Google Search Console so Google finds it faster. Host screens change over time, so buttons may look slightly different.

Part 4 · Connect your systems

20Google Sheet webhook for leads and bookings

One 5-minute setup saves every opt-in, buyer, booking and reservation into your own Google Sheet.

Part 1 · Create the sheet and paste the script

  1. Open sheets.new to create a new Google Sheet. Click "Untitled spreadsheet" and name it, for example "Glow Studio Leads".
  2. In the menu, click Extensions, then Apps Script. A code editor opens in a new tab.
  1. The editor shows a sample function myFunction(). Delete it: click inside the code, press Ctrl + A (Cmd + A on Mac), then Delete.
  1. Click Copy the script below, then click inside the empty editor and paste (Ctrl + V).
  2. Optional: type your email between the quotes on the NOTIFY_EMAIL line (near the top) to get an email for every new entry.
  3. Click the save icon (or press Ctrl + S). You'll see "Saved to Drive".
/**
 * PAHINA BUILDER — Google Sheet Webhook
 * Saves every opt-in, checkout lead, booking and reservation from your Pahina page.
 * Paste this whole file into Apps Script, then Deploy > New deployment > Web app.
 */

// Optional: type your email between the quotes to get an email for every new entry.
const NOTIFY_EMAIL = '';

function doPost(e) {
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(20000);
  try {
    let data = {};
    try { data = JSON.parse((e && e.postData && e.postData.contents) || '{}'); }
    catch (err) { data = (e && e.parameter) || {}; }

    const type = String(data.type || '');
    const tab = type === 'booking_request' ? 'Bookings'
              : type === 'reservation_request' ? 'Reservations'
              : 'Leads';

    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(tab) || ss.insertSheet(tab);

    // Columns grow by themselves when a form sends a new field.
    let headers = sh.getLastColumn() > 0 ? sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, sh.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0] : [];
    if (!headers.length || headers[0] === '') headers = ['received_at'];
    Object.keys(data).forEach(function (k) { if (headers.indexOf(k) === -1) headers.push(k); });
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]).setFontWeight('bold');
    sh.setFrozenRows(1);

    const row = headers.map(function (h) {
      if (h === 'received_at') return new Date();
      let v = data[h] == null ? '' : String(data[h]);
      if (/^[=+\-@]/.test(v)) v = "'" + v;   // keeps the sheet safe from formula tricks
      return v;
    });
    sh.appendRow(row);

    if (NOTIFY_EMAIL) {
      const lines = Object.keys(data).map(function (k) { return k + ': ' + data[k]; }).join('\n');
      MailApp.sendEmail(NOTIFY_EMAIL, 'New ' + tab.toLowerCase().replace(/s$/, '') + ' from your Pahina page', lines);
    }
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({ ok: true })).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

// Open your Web App URL in a browser to check that it works.
function doGet() {
  return ContentService.createTextOutput('Your Pahina Builder webhook is working.');
}

Part 2 · Deploy it as a Web App

  1. Click the blue Deploy button (top right), then New deployment.
  1. Click the gear icon next to "Select type" and choose Web app.
  1. Set Execute as to Me (your email). Set Who has access to Anyone. Then click Deploy.
  1. Click Authorize access. A Google sign-in window opens. If it asks, choose your Google account.
  1. You'll see "Google hasn't verified this app". This is normal: it's your own script, made by you. Click Advanced.
  2. Click Go to Untitled project (unsafe). ("Untitled project" is your script's name.)
  1. The next screen asks what your project can access. Scroll down.
  2. Tick "Select all" so both boxes are checked (Google Sheets, and sending email for your alerts). Then click Continue.

Don't skip "Select all". If the Google Sheets box isn't checked, the script can't save your entries.

  1. Back in Apps Script, you'll see "Deployment successfully updated". Under Web app, click Copy under the URL. It starts with https://script.google.com/macros/s/ and ends with /exec. Then click Done.
  1. Test it: paste the URL in a new browser tab and press Enter. You should see "Your Pahina Builder webhook is working."

Part 3 · Paste the URL into Pahina Builder

WhereWhat to do
Funnel → Email Form Embed Code (opt-in)Replace PASTE_YOUR_APPS_SCRIPT_URL_HERE with your URL. Keep the quotes around it. The checkout "Collect Full Name + Email" form in the Payment tab uses this same URL.
Booking → Google Sheets Webhook URLPaste your URL (Appointment Request Form).
Booking → Reservation SystemPaste your URL in its Google Sheets Webhook URL box.

Then click Generate my page again. New entries appear in your sheet on their own tabs: Leads, Bookings and Reservations. New columns are added automatically.

Changed the script later? Click Deploy, then Manage deployments, the pencil icon, Version: New version, then Deploy. Your URL stays the same.

21Calendly for real-time booking

  1. Sign up free at calendly.com. The free plan gives one event type with unlimited bookings.
  2. Click Create, then a 1-on-1 event. Set the name (for example "30-Min Consultation"), duration and location (Zoom, Google Meet or phone).
  3. Under Availability, connect your Google or Outlook calendar so busy times are blocked automatically.
  4. Click Share on your event, then Add to Website, then Inline Embed, and copy the code.
  5. In Pahina Builder, go to Booking, choose Calendly / External Calendar Embed and paste the code. Generate again.

Visitors now see your real calendar and book instantly. A step-by-step version of this guide is also inside the Booking tab.

Paste the ID or the full snippet in Payment → Tracking & Analytics. Pahina Builder adds the standard events (PageView, Lead, Purchase) for you.

23Cloudinary for fast, light pages

Host photos and videos for free, and paste links instead of uploading.

  1. Sign up free at cloudinary.com.
  2. Open the Media Library and click Upload. Add your photos and short videos.
  3. Open a photo and copy its link (it starts with https://res.cloudinary.com/).
  4. Paste it into any link box in Pahina Builder: Hero image URL, Hero video URL, Logo URL, the Closing banner, or "Or paste an image URL" under each Gallery, Proof, Parallax, About and Story Page photo.
  5. Click Optimize Cloudinary links in the Assets tab for automatic compression.

Linked photos are not stored inside your page file, so your page stays tiny and loads fast, even with many photos.

24Suite: Book, Orders + Stock and Pahina AI

For Pahina Builder Suite owners. Open Suite Tools at the bottom of the sidebar.

Step 1 · Set up everything once with Pahina Connect

Pahina Connect is your one-time setup for Pahina Book, Pahina Orders + Stock and Pahina AI. It takes about 15 minutes and checks every step for you. At the end you get one login for all three tools and a private Connect link to bookmark.

ToolCopy this link from the toolPaste it in Pahina Builder

Generate again. Your "Book now" and "Order now" buttons and your chat bubble now open your live tools.

Part 5 · Grow

25Copy Studio: every kind of copy, from one offer

  1. Open the Copy Studio tab.
  2. Choose a Copy type: long or short sales page, landing page, website, Facebook/Instagram ads, Google Search ads, Messenger/Viber/WhatsApp sales script, video sales letter script, email, 5-email sequence, 20 headlines, link-in-bio, advertorial or a Shopee/Lazada product description.
  3. Choose the Tone, a Formula (AIDA, PAS, BAB and more, or Auto), Length and Language.
  4. Add extra instructions if you like, for example "Mention COD and free shipping".
  5. Keep Expert polish on for a sharper second pass, then click Generate copy.

Every result is saved in Draft history. Click Copy, or Send to Social Manager to turn it into posts.

26Social Manager: a week of posts in one click

  1. Paste content, click Load latest draft, or click Use my offer.
  2. Tick your channels: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok caption and script, Threads, X, LinkedIn, FB/IG ad, Google Search ad, email or Messenger broadcast.
  3. Choose the tone, 1 to 3 variations per channel and the language.
  4. Click Repurpose. Each post appears as a card with Regenerate, Edit, Copy and Delete. Every run is saved as a batch.

27Unlimited pages with My Projects

One Pahina Builder, as many businesses and offers as you like.

Your repeatable workflow

  1. Finish a page, type a project name and click Save Current.
  2. For your next business or offer, change the fields (or apply a Brand Kit) and Generate.
  3. Save it as a new project. Click Load any time to switch between projects, or Duplicate to start from a copy.
  • Projects are backed up to the cloud with your license, so they follow you to other devices. The most recent projects are kept, so export the ones you want to keep forever.
  • Give a page to a client: click Export current funnel and send the .pahina file. Your client opens their own Pahina Builder, then My Projects, then Import project or HTML file. Your Gemini key and license are never included.

Freelancers: one Brand Kit plus one project per client keeps everything organized.

28Import and improve an existing HTML page

Already have a page made somewhere else, for example in Gemini? Bring it into Pahina Builder.

  1. Make sure it's one single HTML file with the styles inside. If the tool gave you separate CSS or JS files, ask it for "a single-file HTML version".
  2. Open My Projects and click Import project or HTML file. Choose your .html file.
  3. Your page loads into the Preview. Use Edit Text, Edit Images, Sections, the AI Assistant or Page Studio to change it.
  4. Click Export, then Download, and put it online (Chapter 19).

Page Studio is made for imported pages: it edits images, videos, sections and words without breaking the original layout.

29Built-in help assistant

Ask anything about Pahina Builder in English or Taglish: "Where do I add my GCash QR?", "Why is my page too big for GitHub?", "How do I add a booking form?". It answers step by step.

30Troubleshooting and FAQ

ProblemFix
"File too large" on GitHubUse ZIP (light), unzip it, and upload index.html and the images folder together. Or host photos on Cloudinary.
Images missing after going onlineUpload the whole unzipped folder, with the images folder next to index.html. Cloudinary links must be public and start with https://.
Page loads slowlyCompress photos at tinypng.com, use Cloudinary links, or upload fewer photos.
My edits are not in the downloadMake sure you downloaded from the same page you edited. Edits are included automatically; if you restored an older version, edit that version again.
The page got cut offGenerate again, or shorten "What's included".
Quota or rate-limit errorWait a minute and try again. Your free Gemini allowance resets over time.
Form entries don't reach my sheetCheck that the Web App access is Anyone, the URL ends with /exec, and you clicked Generate after pasting it.
I see "Upgrade to Suite" but I bought the SuiteClick the access link in your Suite purchase email.
Lost my access on a new deviceClick the access link in your purchase email again.

Quick answers

  • How many pages can I make? Unlimited.
  • Is there a monthly fee? No. You only use your own free Gemini key and free hosting.
  • Who owns the page? You do. It's your file, on your host.
  • Can I sell pages to clients? Yes. Build for them, then hand them the files or a .pahina project.
  • Does Pahina Builder process payments? No. Your payment method (GCash, PayPal, Stripe and others) handles payments; Pahina Builder connects your buttons to it.

No results. Try a different word, like "booking", "GCash" or "upload".
